title: CI/CD Pipeline Playbook Checklist
description: One entry per weakness pattern the invoking AI agent should look for when reviewing CI/CD pipeline config (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile) for issues Checkov's curated rule catalog (rules.py) doesn't reach — unpinned external references, excessive pipeline permissions beyond the one deterministic write-all case, broader script-injection patterns, and broader secrets-in-logs patterns. Jenkinsfile has no deterministic tool coverage at all (verified at plan 013's kickoff), so this playbook is its only mechanism. Not a copy of detectors/auth's checklist.schema.json (023) — this plan's own kickoff judged extracting a shared checklist schema premature given each domain's weaknessClass enum genuinely differs and 023 is already done/stable; revisit if a third playbook-shaped sub-skill appears. A finding the agent produces from an item here must still conform to finding.schema.json.

ruleId.description: The ruleId the agent must stamp on any finding.schema.json finding it produces from this item — same naming convention as every other sub-skill (e.g. 'cicd.unpinned-external-reference').

guidance.description: Concrete instruction to the agent on what to look for in the pipeline config — not a restatement of the CWE definition.

evidenceRequirement.description: What counts as sufficient evidence before reporting this as a finding, not a suspicion — same evidentiary-rigor bar 023 established.

formatNotes.description: Optional per-format idioms to check for (GitHub Actions YAML, GitLab CI YAML, Jenkinsfile Groovy DSL) — mirrors 023's languageNotes shape, renamed since the axis here is pipeline format, not programming language. Not required for every item — the core guidance applies regardless of format; this only adds concrete, format-specific things to check.

references.description: Same shape as finding.schema.json's references[] — reused directly so an agent-produced finding's references can be copied straight from here.

suggestedSeverity.description: A default suggestion, not a hard rule — impact varies by what the pipeline actually does. The agent may adjust based on context, but must not adjust silently: see confidenceGuidance.

defaultMax.description: Upper bound the agent should self-report for a playbook-derived finding of this item, absent stronger corroboration — deliberately lower than a deterministic detector's typical confidence.
